L17: ## Automatic Transmission
L18: 
L19: ﻿
L20: 
L21: 【3†Image: WARNING†www.fordservicecontent.dealerconnection.com】   WARNING:  Do not apply the brake pedal and accelerator pedal simultaneously. Applying both pedals simultaneously for more than a few seconds will limit engine performance, which may result in difficulty maintaining speed in traffic and could lead to serious injury.
L22: 
L23: Note:   When you switch the ignition off, the transmission will carry out a series of checks. You may hear slight clicking sounds. This is normal.
L24: We have designed your vehicle to improve fuel economy by reducing fuel usage compared to a traditional torque converter automatic transmission. When you take your foot off the accelerator pedal and your vehicle begins to slow down, this can feel like a light to medium braking sensation.
L25: 
L26: Selector Lever Positions
L27: 【4†Image: Transmission Selector Lever†www.fordservicecontent.dealerconnection.com】
L28: P【5†Image】Park
L29: R【5†Image】Reverse
L30: N【5†Image】Neutral
L31: D【5†Image】Drive
L32: S【5†Image】Sport mode or manual shifting
L33: +【5†Image】Manual shift up
L34: -【5†Image】Manual shift down
L35: 
L36: Press the button on the front of the transmission selector lever to change to each position.
L37: 
L38: The transmission selector lever position will be shown in the information display.
L39: 
L40: P (Park)
L41: Your vehicle will not move while the transmission selector lever is in P. You can start the engine with the transmission selector lever in this position.
L42: 
L43: Note:   An audible warning will sound if you open the driver's door and you have not moved the transmission selector lever to park.
L44: 
L45: R (Reverse)
L46: 
L47: With the transmission selector lever in R, power is transmitted to the drive wheels to allow your vehicle to move backward. You cannot start the engine with the transmission selector lever in this position.
L48: Note:   Always come to a complete stop before shifting the transmission selector lever out of reverse.
L49: 
L50: N (Neutral)
L51: 
L52: With the transmission selector lever in N, power is not transmitted to the drive wheels and the transmission is not locked, it is possible your vehicle will move if the brakes are not applied. You can start the engine with the transmission selector lever in this position.
L53: 
L54: D (Drive)
L55: With the transmission selector lever in D, your vehicle will shift automatically through the forward gears. You cannot start the engine with the transmission selector lever in this position.
L56: 
L57: The transmission will select the appropriate gear for optimum vehicle performance and economy based on ambient temperature, road gradient, vehicle load, speed and your driving style.
L58: 
L59: When you use Drive mode it provides a downshift function. See Downshift in this section.
L60: Note:   A shift will occur only when your vehicle and engine speeds are appropriate.
L61: 
L62: Sport Mode and Manual Shifting
L63: 
L64: Sport Mode
L65: 
L66: With the transmission selector lever in S, gears are selected quicker and at higher engine speeds. You cannot start the engine with the transmission selector lever in this position.
L67: Sport mode will remain on until you either shift manually up or down the gears using the + or - buttons on the side of the transmission selector lever or you move the transmission selector lever to drive.
L68: 
L69: When you use Sport mode it provides a downshift function. See Downshift in this section.
L70: 
L71: Manual Shifting
L72: 
L73: Press the + button to shift up and the - button to shift down.
L74: 
L75: Gears may be skipped by pressing the + or - buttons repeatedly at short intervals.
L76: Manual mode also provides a downshift function. See Downshift in this section.
L77: 
L78: Note:   The transmission will automatically upshift if the engine speed is too high or downshift if the engine speed is too low.
L79: 
L80: Hints on Driving with an Automatic Transmission
L81: 
L82: Note:   The system carries out a series of checks when you switch the ignition on and off. You may hear clicking sounds. This is normal.
L83: 
L84: Moving off
L85: 
L86:   1. Press the brake pedal to apply the brakes.
L87:   1. Move the transmission selector lever to R, D or S.
L88: 
L89:   1. Release the parking brake.
L90: 
L91:   1. Release the brake pedal and press the accelerator pedal.
L92: 
L93: Stopping
L94: 
L95:   1. Release the accelerator pedal and press the brake pedal.
L96: 
L97:   1. Apply the parking brake.
L98: 
L99:   1. Move the transmission selector lever to N or P.
L100: 
L101: Downshift
L102: Press the accelerator pedal fully with the transmission selector lever in either D, S mode or manual shifting position to select a lower gear for optimum performance. Release the accelerator pedal when you no longer require downshift.
L103: 
L104: If Your Vehicle Gets Stuck In Mud or Snow
L105: 
L106: If your vehicle gets stuck in mud or snow, it may be rocked out by shifting between D and R, stopping between shifts in a steady pattern. Press the accelerator lightly in each gear.
L107: Note:   Do not rock your vehicle if the engine is not at normal operating temperature as this can damage the transmission.
L108: 
L109: Note:   Do not rock your vehicle for more than a minute as this can damage the transmission or the tires and the engine may overheat.
L110: 
L111: Emergency Park Position Release Lever
L112: 【3†Image: WARNING†www.fordservicecontent.dealerconnection.com】   WARNING:  Do not drive your vehicle until you verify that the stoplamps are working.
L113: 【3†Image: WARNING†www.fordservicecontent.dealerconnection.com】   WARNING:  If the parking brake is fully released, but the brake warning lamp remains illuminated, the brakes may not be working properly. Have your vehicle checked as soon as possible.
L114: 【3†Image: WARNING†www.fordservicecontent.dealerconnection.com】   WARNING:  When doing this procedure, you need to take the transmission out of park (P) which means your vehicle can roll freely. To avoid unwanted vehicle movement, always fully apply the parking brake prior to doing this procedure. Use wheels chocks if appropriate.
L115: Use the emergency P position release lever to move the transmission selector lever from the P position in the event of a malfunction or if your vehicle battery has no charge.
L116: 
L117: 【6†Image: Center Console†www.fordservicecontent.dealerconnection.com】
L118: 
L119:   1. Apply the parking brake and switch the ignition off before carrying out this procedure.
L120: 
L121:   1. Remove the retaining screw.
L122: 
L123:   1. Remove the center console side panel.
L124: 【7†Image: Automatic Lever Removal †www.fordservicecontent.dealerconnection.com】
L125:   1. Press the brake pedal. Using a suitable tool rotate the lever forward while pulling the transmission selector lever out of the P position.
L126: 
L127: Note:   The emergency P position release lever is pink.
L128: 
L129: Note:   See an authorized dealer as soon as possible if you use procedure.
